top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing the special care statement.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care, but did not report to Child Care Licensing within two days of becoming notified.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard. A caregiver utilized inappropriate language when referring to a child.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it was determined the director is in charge of a group of children in a classroom on a daily basis. Being in a classroom at all times prevents the director from   conducting their responsibilities which includes supervising staff.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.
